# Harrison

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c1 P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** A crank  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Harrison is described as a fussy, fidgety little man. He is seen sitting on his veranda in his shirt sleeves enjoying his evening pipe.

_Sources: [v2 c3 P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039)_

## Personality

Mr. Harrison is a crusty, crabbed, and outspoken man who believes in telling the truth, even if it is disagreeable to others. He has a quick, irritable temper and gets easily nervous or vexed, but he can also be friendly, hospitable, and mild-mannered. Although he purports to dislike women and keep to himself, he enjoys neighborly visits and develops a fond appreciation for Anne Shirley.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c3 P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001), [v2 c3 P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 c3 P46](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0046), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c9 P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005)_

- Maintain his independent, quiet bachelor lifestyle  <sub>[v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>

## History

In early April, Mr. J. A. Harrison bought Mr. Robert Bell's farm adjoining Green Gables and relocated to Avonlea from New Brunswick. He quickly developed a reputation among the locals as an eccentric crank due to his erratic meal schedules, unusual dishwashing habits, and outright refusal to subscribe to church funds or gossip with Mrs. Rachel Lynde. After a confrontation regarding Anne Shirley's stray cow, he unexpectedly formed a warm, friendly acquaintance with Anne when she came to confess to selling his Jersey cow by mistake. Though initially annoyed by his sailor brother's foul-mouthed parrot, Ginger, Mr. Harrison remains deeply attached to the bird despite the trouble it causes. He later expresses support for the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, enjoying Anne's visits and lighthearted company.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P7](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0007), [v2 c1 P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 c3 P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001), [v2 c3 P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 c3 P16](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0016), [v2 c3 P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)_
